A '''Twi'lek militia safehouse''' was established in an underground district of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]], a small [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ryloth]]. The [[safehouse]] was founded during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] by a group of [[Twi'lek militia|Twi'lek militants]], who sought to protect [[Twi'lek/Legends|their people]] from harassment and exploitation at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of offworld criminals.

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek militia's Nabat safehouse was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[2012]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure, ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
